comparison.objective: Open a glued phone display with suction and opening tools, then park the tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Adhesive separation, controlled prying, tool coordination, and hinge-limited opening.
comparison.success_condition: All adhesive released, display supported within its limit, tools returned, and arms home; thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Adhesive disassembly does not test adjustable-stop locking or retained functional motion.
